changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'security' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Rule') BEGIN create table [security].[Rule] ( Id bigint identity not null, [Uid] uniqueidentifier not null, [Name] nvarchar(250) not null, RoleId int not null, SecurityType int not null, AssetTypeId int not null, ApplyToType bit not null, IsVisible bit not null, [State] int constraint DF_Security_Rule_State default(1) not null, Context nvarchar(max) sparse, CreatedBy int not null, CreatedOn datetime not null, UpdatedBy int not null, UpdatedOn datetime not null, constraint [PK_Security_Rule] primary key clustered ( Id ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Security_Rule_Uid_Include') BEGIN create nonclustered index [IX_Security_Rule_Uid_Include] on [security].[Rule] ( [Uid] ) include (RoleId, AssetTypeId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Security_Rule_AssetTypeId_Include') BEGIN create nonclustered index [IX_Security_Rule_AssetTypeId_Include] on [security].[Rule] ( [Uid] ) include (RoleId) END
if exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'security' and TABLE_NAME = 'Rule' and COLUMN_NAME = 'IsOverride') begin alter table [security].[Rule] drop column IsOverride; end
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'security' and TABLE_NAME = 'Rule' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Context') begin alter table [security].[Rule] add Context nvarchar(max) sparse; end
if not exists (select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'security' and TABLE_NAME = 'Rule' and COLUMN_NAME = 'State') begin alter table [security].[Rule] add [State] int constraint DF_Security_Rule_State default(1) not null; end
